Date: 2022-11-02 What is claimed is:
1. A questionnaire apparatus comprising:
one or more processors; and
one or more memories storing one or more programs that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to execute:
managing one or more questions prepared for a passenger of an autonomous driving vehicle to evaluate autonomous driving performed by the autonomous driving vehicle;
acquiring driving environment information and driving state information related to the autonomous driving; and
determining one or more request questions for requesting an answer from the passenger from among one or more managed questions based on at least one of the driving environment information and the driving state information.
2. The questionnaire apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the determining one or more request questions includes prioritizing the one or more questions, and when a number of the one or more request questions exceeds a predetermined number, determining the one or more request questions in descending order of priority so that the number of the one or more request questions is equal to or less than the predetermined number.
3. The questionnaire apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the one or more request questions include one or more fixed questions determined regardless of the driving environment information and the driving state information.
4. The questionnaire apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the one or more programs, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more programs to execute:
acquiring an answer to the one or more request questions; and
evaluating the autonomous driving based on the answer.
5. The questionnaire apparatus according to claim 3, wherein the one or more programs, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more programs to execute:
acquiring an answer to the one or more request questions; and
evaluating the autonomous driving based on the answer.
6. The questionnaire apparatus according to claim 5, wherein the one or more fixed questions include one or more mandatory questions, and
the evaluating the autonomous driving is performed only when an answer to the one or more mandatory questions is acquired.
7. A questionnaire method comprising:
managing one or more questions prepared for a passenger of an autonomous driving vehicle to evaluate autonomous driving performed by the autonomous driving vehicle;
acquiring driving environment information and driving state information related to the autonomous driving; and
determining one or more request questions for requesting an answer from the passenger from among one or more managed questions based on at least one of the driving environment information and the driving state information.
8. A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program configured to cause a computer to execute:
managing one or more questions prepared for a passenger of an autonomous driving vehicle to evaluate autonomous driving performed by the autonomous driving vehicle;
acquiring driving environment information and driving state information related to the autonomous driving; and
determining one or more request questions for requesting an answer from the passenger from among one or more managed questions based on at least one of the driving environment information and the driving state information. 19 20
